smyx-living-alone-rhythm-anomaly-analysis v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Analyzes night-time video from a fixed camera in a living-alone person's home to detect lights-off time and early-morning activity.
- Builds a 7-14 day personal baseline for sleep rhythm; flags anomalies if lights-off is delayed >2 hours or early-morning movement exceeds baseline by >2 standard deviations.
- Generates daily rhythm reports and issues reminders to family or community workers on significant anomalies.
- Strict open-id acquisition procedure for report retrieval and data operations.
- Use cases include elderly living alone, single apartments, and remote health monitoring.
